headline: Io Beta 0.8.1
intro: Io Beta 0.8.1: the changes since Beta 0.8.
notes: Kernel: Linux 7.3: Valve's 7.3.1-valve2 with stable 7.3.4 (linux-neptune-73); the display setting amdgpu.dcdebugmask=0x60000 as on SteamOS. Kernel 7.2 stays installed as a fallback.
Boot: no more hang at the boot logo (SDDM waits for elogind). The Io logo at boot, the animated Io Torus during firmware updates.
Patch notes: Io's own notes on Steam's SteamOS update page (this page), listed before later Steam client updates.
Desktop: Steam shares the screen without a prompt; text from Steam's on-screen keyboard arrives correctly; "Add to Steam" in Dolphin is safe with any file name.
Screen reader: Orca with Valve's patches keeps running when speech settings change.
Wi-Fi and Bluetooth: NetworkManager with Valve's ARP fix, bluez 5.88.
Power: shutdown and reboot from the power menu no longer crash elogind; hibernation stays off, as on SteamOS; better battery time estimates (vpower 1.6.4).
Storage: SD cards are rescanned through Valve's helper; clearer error messages from the SD card and format tools.
Graphics and audio: Mesa 26.2.7, gamescope-wsi 3.17.0, steamdeck-dsp 1.04.
